text:
maria: Quick sync — postmortem action items from yesterday's authz token drift. I listed owners and timelines below, need confirmations. /cc @oliver @jun :wave:

oliver: I can take ownership of token validation healthchecks. I'll add a cron probe + alert. ETA: Thu EOD.

jun: I'll own the audit-logging gap. Quick note: some service accounts weren't emitting audit events due to a missing env var.

maria: thanks. Can you paste the failing log snippet?

jun: ```WARN authz: token validation failed for svc:payments - missing X-AUDIT=1
stack: authz/validator.go:213```

kara: from product side, we need a regeneration and migration plan for long-lived tokens. Target: force rotation within 30 days for legacy tokens.

maria: Action list (owners/dates):
1) validation healthcheck — owner: oliver, due: 72h
2) audit logging fix — owner: jun, due: 48h
3) secret rotation plan & migration docs — owner: kara, due: 7d
4) retro + runbook updates — owner: maria, due: next sprint

oliver: agree. For healthcheck I'll push this probe: ```curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer test' https://internal/authz/validate | jq .status``` then alert on status!="ok". Adding prometheus alert and pager.

maria: Jun — can you confirm which service accounts missed logs and whether keys need rotation?

jun: svc accounts affected: payments-worker-prod, importer-prod. payments key expired, importer missing AUDIT env. Rotating payments key now; importer will get env fix deployed.

rotbot: Incident 2145550000 - token-drift detected — status: in_progress (automated) :gear:

maria: good catch bot. Kara, product impact matrix for rotation? We need to tag customer-owned tokens so rotations are coordinated.

kara: I'll draft a migration doc. Suggest phased enforcement: warn -> enforced -> rotation required. Will post PR in docs repo by Tue.

maria: timeline recap: oliver 72h, jun 48h (in progress), kara 7d, maria retro next Thursday.

oliver: creating PR for healthcheck + alerting rule, tagging oncall.

jun: payments key rotated. importer env updated. Manual re-ingest job scheduled to backfill audit events.

maria: Please add status updates here as you complete items. I'll close out when retro slides are posted.

oliver: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/402 (healthcheck + alert)

kara: doc PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/128 (migration plan draft)

maria: added action tracker card: https://app.clubhouse.io/redwood/story/9876

jun: quick ops note: pattern detection — this is the 3rd token-drift incident in ~6 months for exporter/importer services. Recommend monthly audit job and an automated alert when drift > 5% of tokens.

maria: good call. Added "recurring audit job" as backlog item to the clubhouse card; we'll prioritize next sprint.

oliver: ack. I'll include an automated weekly summary report to #eng-sre with the probe results.

maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:
